svg.title: Vector add, instruction by instruction, with its scoreboards
svg.desc: The 21 real instructions of the first kernel. Lines on the left join an instruction that sets a scoreboard to the later instruction that waits on it; amber bars are fixed stall cycles.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slow instructions (constant loads, special registers, memory loads) set one of six scoreboards. A later instruction

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that needs the result waits on it. Fast instructions stall a fixed number of cycles instead. My encoder writes these bits.
